about.title: Understanding medical language with clarity
about.lead: Medical reports can be hard to follow because they use clinical language. MedSimplify helps break down the key details into plain language.
about.doesText: It highlights key findings, explains medical terms, and simplifies report language so patients and families can better understand the content.
about.doesNotText: It does not diagnose conditions, recommend treatment, or replace professional medical advice.
about.note: Always use the original report and a clinician's guidance as the final source for care decisions.
